definition: a thing put over something to protect it
description: In a narrow cobbled lane of brick houses on a wet autumn day, an old red sports car is parked by the wall, almost completely hidden under a fitted grey fabric cover that is soaked with rain. The cover has slipped off at the front corner, showing a red wing and a round chrome headlight. A gust lifts the front of the cover, showing the chrome grille and number plate, then it drops back into place. Water drips onto the cobbles and yellow leaves lie on the car and the ground.

to stand in a square planter
